name: London Bus Museum at Brooklands, Weybridge
summary: The London Bus Museum preserves the world's largest collection of working historic London buses, tracing almost two centuries of public transport through horse buses, early motor buses, classic double-deckers, uniforms and other artefacts, in its own building at Brooklands.
reasonToVisit: The world's largest collection of working historic London buses
planningDetail: One ticket covers both museums; heritage bus rides usually run weekends and Surrey school holidays, subject to availability
